name: settings-four
title: Settings Four
description: A stacked account settings form for name, email, avatar, user ID, and account deletion.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
	import UserIcon from "@lucide/svelte/icons/user";
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import {
		InputGroup,
		InputGroupAddon,
		InputGroupInput
	} from "#lib/components/ui/input-group/index.js";
	import SettingField from "./setting-field.svelte";
	import SettingsSection from "./settings-section.svelte";
</script>

<SettingsSection hint="Max 32 characters." hintId="display-name-hint">
	{#snippet action()}<Button type="button">Save Changes</Button>{/snippet}
	<SettingField
		description="This is your display name on Efferd."
		htmlFor="display-name"
		label="Your Name"
	>
		<InputGroup>
			<InputGroupAddon><UserIcon aria-hidden="true" /></InputGroupAddon>
			<InputGroupInput
				aria-describedby="display-name-hint"
				autocomplete="name"
				id="display-name"
				maxlength={32}
				value="Bhide Svelte"
			/>
		</InputGroup>
	</SettingField>
</SettingsSection>

<script lang="ts">
	import AtSignIcon from "@lucide/svelte/icons/at-sign";
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import {
		InputGroup,
		InputGroupAddon,
		InputGroupInput
	} from "#lib/components/ui/input-group/index.js";
	import SettingField from "./setting-field.svelte";
	import SettingsSection from "./settings-section.svelte";
</script>

<SettingsSection
	hint="We'll send a confirmation link before this address updates."
	hintId="email-hint"
>
	{#snippet action()}<Button type="button">Save Changes</Button>{/snippet}
	<SettingField
		description="Used to log in and receive notifications. Confirmation required for changes."
		htmlFor="email"
		label="Your Email"
	>
		<InputGroup>
			<InputGroupAddon><AtSignIcon aria-hidden="true" /></InputGroupAddon>
			<InputGroupInput
				aria-describedby="email-hint"
				autocomplete="email"
				id="email"
				type="email"
				value="email@example.com"
			/>
		</InputGroup>
	</SettingField>
</SettingsSection>
{#snippet action()}{/snippet}
clipboard.copy(userId)} size="icon-xs" > {#if clipboard.copied}{:else}{/if} {clipboard.status === "success" ? "User ID copied" : clipboard.status === "failure" ? "Failed to copy user ID" : ""}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import SettingField from "./setting-field.svelte";
	import SettingsSection from "./settings-section.svelte";
</script>

<SettingsSection>
	{#snippet action()}
		<Button id="delete-account" type="button" variant="destructive">Delete Account</Button>
	{/snippet}
	<SettingField
		description="Deletes your account and all data. This cannot be undone."
		htmlFor="delete-account"
		label="Delete Account"
	/>
</SettingsSection>

{@render children()} {#if hint || action} {#if hint}

{hint}

{/if} {@render action?.()} {/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		Field,
		FieldContent,
		FieldDescription,
		FieldLabel
	} from "#lib/components/ui/field/index.js";
	import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";

	type Props = ComponentProps<typeof Field> & {
		label: string;
		htmlFor: string;
		description: string;
		children?: Snippet;
	};

	let { label, htmlFor, description, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Field orientation="responsive" {...restProps}>
	<FieldContent>
		<FieldLabel class="mb-1" for={htmlFor}>{label}</FieldLabel>
		<FieldDescription>{description}</FieldDescription>
	</FieldContent>
	{#if children}
		<FieldContent>{@render children()}</FieldContent>
	{/if}
</Field>
